name: claude-octopus
description: Multi-LLM orchestration with Double Diamond workflows, provider routing, safety gates, and automation. Dispatches to Codex, Antigravity, Cursor CLI, Grok, Copilot, Qwen, Perplexity, OpenRouter, OrcaRouter, Ollama, OpenCode, and Kimi Code from a single plugin.

interface.longDescription: Claude Octopus helps developers research questions, scope requirements, implement plans, and review changes with multiple AI providers. Start by explicitly invoking $skill-doctor to check plugin health and provider setup. Install and authenticate the provider CLIs or configure API access required by your chosen workflow. External calls use your own provider accounts and may incur usage charges. Check provider availability and agree on scope before dispatch. Invoke a skill explicitly to begin; enabling the plugin does not start a workflow.
defaultPrompt: Use $skill-doctor to check my Octopus setup and report provider readiness without repairs.
Use $flow-discover to research OAuth patterns after checking provider availability and costs.
Use $skill-code-review to review my current changes; present findings without posting to GitHub.
